meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会把代码库按功能分组画成流程图,找出不同功能里重复的部分,并提出一套最简单的统一架构。最后生成重复报告、统一流程图和可复制给 /make-plan 的计划提示,而不是直接写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你问 Claude「找到理想路径」、要求统一重复的系统,或在重构前做架构审计时,会触发这个技能。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 找出这个项目的理想路径
say.note: Claude 会开始分析代码库并绘制流程图。

say.text: 帮我统一代码库中重复的系统,生成架构建议
say.note: 它会产出重复报告和统一方案。

say.text: 重构前审计一下架构,给出统一流程图
say.note: Claude 将按阶段执行并生成所有工件。

howto.what_en: Claude maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, and proposes a unified architecture. It outputs diagrams, a duplication report, a unified flowchart, and /make-plan handoff prompts instead of code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to 'find the ideal path,' unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to find the ideal path in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the codebase and draw flowcharts.

say_en.text: Unify the duplicated systems in the codebase and propose an architecture.
say_en.note: It will produce a duplication report and unified plan.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture before refactoring and give a unified flowchart.
say_en.note: Claude runs through all phases and generates artifacts.
